definition: `FilteredNecessaryExistence F admissible x w` requires necessary exemplification of every admissible candidate essence Φ of x at w, where `FilteredEssence` admits only comparison properties Ψ satisfying that same fixed `admissible` predicate. `admissible = True` reconstructs Scott's NE; admitting only world-invariant properties makes this test universal under possibilist constant-domain quantification. This is not the historical AFP NE or a claim of metaphysical existence.
note: Controlled variation of both higher-order property quantifiers for #274. Theories identifying admissibility with metaphysically genuine properties need independent premises; no candidate property restriction is assumed true in the Catholic case.
